title: An integral, universally injective, surjective morphism is a universal homeomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], universally injective [def-weil-radicial-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism]. Then $f$ is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]: for every morphism of schemes $Y'\to Y$ the projection $X\times_YY'\to Y'$ from the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is a homeomorphism of underlying topological spaces.
